description: This file defines the StoreScreen widget for a Flutter app, which displays a grid of audiobooks for purchase. It uses providers to access audiobook data and library state, and includes UI elements such as a grid view and purchase handling.

classes.name: StoreScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a grid of audiobooks available for purchase in the store.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the StoreScreen, including a GridView of audiobook cards with purchase functionality.
